basic_details.job_title: MAIDS Project Scientist I (Dental Technology Innovation Hub) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One post of Project Scientist-I is open on contract basis at the Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences (MAIDS), New Delhi, under the project "Design and prototype fabrication of Ultrasound (US) based tooth pulp vitality tester", sanctioned under the Technology Development Program of the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India. The post carries Rs. 56,000 + 27% HRA, needs a B. Tech in any discipline from a recognised university or equivalent, and runs for 6 months or till the end date of the project, whichever is earlier. Applications in the prescribed format opened on 13 No

how_to_apply: MAIDS accepts only paper applications for this post, handed in directly or sent by post. The application form (prescribed format) is attached to the notice.

Fill in the application form in the prescribed format: post applied for, name, father's name, permanent and postal address, contact number, email ID, date of birth, qualifications (examination, division/% of marks, board/university, year of passing) and work experience.
Mark the post applied for clearly on top of the application form.
Affix a recent passport size photograph on the form.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates in support of age, qualification(s) and experience, and tick the documents attached in item 9 of the form.
Sign the declaration at the end of the form.

Deliver the application by hand or by post to: Principal Investigator, Dental Technology Innovation Hub, Room No. 309, 3rd Floor, Phase II Building, Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, MAMC Campus, BS Zafar Marg, New Delhi-110002.
Make sure it reaches on or before 27 November 2026 up to 12:00 noon. The institute will not be responsible for any postal delay on the part of any delivery agency.
One passport size photograph (the checklist in the application form lists two passport size photographs along with the application form)
Self-attested copies of educational / technical / academic / professional certificates
The form states that in case of short documents, the application is likely to be rejected.
important_instructions: Applications lacking complete information as per the proforma or failing to include copies of relevant documents will be liable to be rejected without any communication. The Competent Authority reserves the right to change the number of vacancies, withdraw the process in full or in part, and reject any or all applications without assigning reasons or giving notice. If any information furnished is found incorrect at any point of time, the candidature is liable to be cancelled even after selection. For queries, contact Mr. Deepak Kumar at 9953312951 between 02:00 and 04:00 pm, Monday to Friday. No email communications will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About MAIDS Project Scientist-I
content_sections.text: The Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences is an autonomous institution under the Govt. of NCT of Delhi, located at the MAMC Complex, Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi. The Project Scientist-I will work on a Department of Science & Technology project to design and fabricate a prototype ultrasound-based tooth pulp vitality tester. Applications are handled by the project's Principal Investigator at the institute's Dental Technology Innovation Hub.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The eligibility for the Project Scientist-I post at MAIDS is printed as follows: Essential qualification: B. Tech in any discipline from a recognised university or equivalent. Desirable qualification: M. Tech in any discipline. Age limit: Not more than 35 years. Age and experience will be reckoned with respect to the last date of closure of applications, which is 27 November 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Scientist-I gets Rs. 56,000 plus 27% HRA, as printed in the notice. No TA/DA or other allowances will be paid to candidates for the interview or for joining the post. The post is purely on contract basis and subject to the end date of the project. The contract is for a period of 6 months or the end date of the project, whichever is earlier. The contract may be extended based on performance and extension granted by DST. The incumbent will have no right to regular appointment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MAIDS Project Scientist-I
content_sections.text: MAIDS accepts only paper applications for this post, handed in directly or sent by post. The application form (prescribed format) is attached to the notice. Fill in the application form in the prescribed format: post applied for, name, father's name, permanent and postal address, contact number, email ID, date of birth, qualifications (examination, division/% of marks, board/university, year of passing) and work experience. Mark the post applied for clearly on top of the application form. Affix a recent passport size photograph on the form. Attach self-attested copies of certificates in support of age, qualification(s) and experience, and tick the documents attached in item 9 of the form. Sign the declaration at the end of the form. Deliver the application by hand or by post to: Principal Investigator, Dental Technology Innovation Hub, Room No. 309, 3rd Floor, Phase II Building, Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, MAMC Campus, BS Zafar Marg, New Delhi-110002. Make sure it reaches on or before 27 November 2026 up to 12:00 noon. The institute will not be responsible for any postal delay on the part of any delivery agency. One passport size photograph (the checklist in the application form lists two passport size photographs along with the application form) Self-attested copy of age proof Self-attested copies of educational / technical / academic / professional certificates Self-attested experience certificate, if any The form states that in case of short documents, the application is likely to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the MAIDS Project Scientist-I post has two stages: Shortlisting: the Competent Authority will scrutinise the applications and documents, and only candidates meeting the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted. Interview: shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. The further evaluation will be notified through the institutional website. The interview date is not specified in the notice. A list of selected and waitlisted candidates will be displayed on the institutional website. The decision of the Competent Authority regarding selection will be final, and no representations will be entertained.
